_note: This is a sample/test data file for dashboard display. Contains placeholder values.

overview.notes: Catalog of npm scripts and CI workflows available from the Tools page — run counts are not measured until wired to live telemetry.

tools.name: Simplebeacon Scan
tools.description: Regenerate .simplebeacon/report.json with gate rules (npm run simplebeacon).

tools.name: Baseline Sync
tools.description: Update Jest counts in .simplebeacon/baseline.json (npm run simplebeacon:baseline-sync).

tools.name: npm audit
tools.description: Live dependency vulnerability scan via the dashboard API.

tools.name: Consolidation Scan
tools.description: Find duplicate JSON, similar schemas, and oversized files under configured sample paths.

tools.name: Pre-PR Gate
tools.description: Offline gate scan plus gate status (npm run simplebeacon:pre-pr).

tools.name: Environment Audit
tools.description: Scan for missing or undocumented environment variables (npm run env:audit).

tools.name: Compliance Check
tools.description: Validate compliance trail against the latest scan report (npm run compliance:check).

tools.name: Fiction KPI Guard
tools.description: Detect hardcoded KPIs in sample data and server stubs (npm run guard:fiction-kpi:ci).

workflows.name: Simplebeacon Enterprise Guardrail
workflows.description: SB-ENT rules, credentials, and structural intent (profile: enterprise). Monorepo root: .github/workflows/simplebeacon-enterprise-gate.yml

workflows.name: SimpleBeacon AI Hygiene Gate
workflows.description: Token bleed, architecture drift, Python + JS AST rules. Monorepo root: .github/workflows/simplebeacon-ai-hygiene-gate.yml

workflows.name: npm publish
workflows.description: Publish simplebeacon to npm on GitHub Release tag simplebeacon-v* (CascadeProjects/.github/workflows/simplebeacon-npm-publish.yml). Requires NPM_TOKEN secret.

workflows.name: Pre-push Hook
workflows.description: Local git hook: gate scan with Jest evidence (npm run sb:hook:pre-push).
